calendar_binding.forecast_rule: a forecast is an OUTPUT scored at its issuer's record (naming-collapse registry convention) — calendar anchors are DATA ON THE SUBJECT, not a new participant class
calendar_binding.register: deadline-reminders/v1 (~/workspace/tracking/deadline-reminders-register.json, Tracking lane d6c12f3a; primary calendar, America/Los_Angeles)
calendar_binding.scheme: A CUSHION-3d · B CUSHION/landing · C WALL-day · D ESCALATION (wall-4h) · E FINAL (wall-30m); anchors carry {cushion[], landing, wall, final} mapped from the register stages per subject

conformity.B1_one_record_per_subject: each subject carries exactly ONE expectation record (Bayesian shape); positions cite the subject record; no per-position re-estimates, no parallel numbers on views/ledger lines
conformity.B2_basis_cited: every position names its basis surface(s) per speculation registration PR #3766; uncited = invalid, does not open
conformity.B3_settlement_record_of_record_only: each subject names its record of record at book open; settlement ONLY from that record; other surfaces are evidence legs into the posterior, never settlement sources
conformity.B4_private_ledger_first: B4 as ruled (owner ruling via main 2026-11-02, discharged by DoE): PRIVATE LEDGER FIRST stands — ledger of record unchanged, entries internal, stakes observational, no external participation — AND a public READ-ONLY render of the ledger records on our own dashboard is authorized (book-feed.json). Render conformity: (R1) published values = ledger values verbatim, the render computes/re-estimates nothing; (R2) expectation records display TRUE STATE — INTAKE/null priors + posteriors shown as-is, never dressed, interpolated or hidden; (R3) read-only means read-only — no entry/position path from the public surface. The original no-listing condition is SUPERSEDED by this ruling; the PASS stands.
conformity.B5_rules9_significance: Rule 9 + significance standard bind any stated probability/standing from the book (single-leg = HELD, sub-bar = no established language); the hidden metrics_internal winprob stays in its own home — the book cites records, it does not republish that metric values; stakes observational units per lane scope guard
conformity.criteria: DoE conformity criteria for the first wagering book (doe-expert, 2026-11-02) — pass issued by DoE before entries open

exclusions.key: exclusion keys on the TEST STAMP — any item carrying the instance-#2 test stamp is excluded regardless of filing shape or claimed substance
exclusions.reentry: only via a qualifying change: DoE+main ruling that a substance is real AND entry-material (re-enters via the normal leg), or the owner direct word
exclusions.rule: OWNER RULING (via main, 2026-11-03): the six EGM instance-#2 test filings (DoE rubric experiment, test-stamped — incl. the deliberately refuted claim in perfect filing shape) are REDACTED from this book and all winnings/opportunities surfaces
exclusions.scope: money-facing surfaces only; the experiment own record (DoE lane) is untouched
exclusions.status_at_registration: VERIFIED CLEAN 2026-11-03 — marker scan (EGM / instance-#2 / test-stamp) over book + feed + ledger + lane.json = 0 hits; no instance-#2 item in subjects, ledger, positions or queue (positions 0; subject intake = challenge manager list + C12 only)

ledger_of_record.note: MoneyBall v2 is the scoring surface (positions' basis + settlement scoring reference), NOT the ledger. Neon is the fleet telemetry/lane-events store, NOT this ledger. The ledger of record is the append-only in-repo ledger below (git history = the private record).

participants: gambler (canonical participant class per naming-collapse registry, AGENT-MONIKERS.md #3828/#3830); aliases speculator/bettor/wagerer resolve to gambler at the listing layer only — records stay per-class

position_rules.basis: every position cites its information basis (surface + record/artifact ref, per the speculation registration); uncited = invalid position
position_rules.settlement: observed outcome per the subject's resolution source vs the position; settle action; settlement does not bypass dual-gate
position_rules.stakes: observational units / soft quota tokens only; internal only

priority_timebox_linkage.checkpoint_rule: at each tier boundary for a subject: (1) review/revise its ONE expectation record — evidence legs appended, posterior updated per B1 (no parallel numbers); (2) first entries open at a checkpoint only with basis cited per B2 + the subject record cited; (3) settlement still ONLY from record_of_record at knowable (B3), tiers never settle
priority_timebox_linkage.relation: the book subjects are the same slate viewed as stakes; the desk-feed tier boundaries are this book expectation checkpoints
